userStories.title: Refresh every installed ACP agent with /model refresh
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Let users explicitly re-probe every installed ACP agent and see one ordered transcript result per agent.

**Motivation** — A user who wants to start on, or switch to, a specific ACP model cannot see or pick it first.

**Approach** — Add `AcpRefreshResult` and `AcpCatalog.refresh(cwd)`, add optional `ChatHost.refreshAcpModels()` implemented by `NativeChatHost`, and make `/model refresh` print one line per agent.

Manual: `refresh(cwd)` probes every installed agent regardless of learned, saved or warm-probed offers.

At most one probe per agent is in flight: a `warm` or `refresh` that finds a probe for that agent already running reuses it rather than starting another. A probe that succeeds is handled exactly as `opened(`acp:<agent>`, capabilities)`. A probe that fails is handled exactly as `failed(`acp:<agent>`, error)` and logged at debug. After `close()`, a probe that settles is not learned, not recorded as a failure, and not saved.

`ChatHost` interface (`chat-host.ts`). Target: gains optional `refreshAcpModels?(): Promise<readonly AcpRefreshResult[]>`; `NativeChatHost` implements it as `this.deps.acp?.refresh(this.deps.cwd)`, or `[]` without a catalog (US-003).

`runSlashCommand` `case "model"` (`slash-commands.ts`). Target: the argument `refresh` runs the refresh (US-003); every other argument still switches.

`/model refresh` runs when the first argument is exactly the lowercase `refresh` (further arguments are ignored); any other first argument, including `Refresh`, is still a model switch, so a model whose id is literally `refresh` cannot be picked by name (it remains pickable in the picker).

A refresh result's `models` is the number of model ids the probe reported, not the number of rows the picker shows. A refresh result's `failed` reason is the catalog's existing open-failure reason (`not logged in` for `AGENT_SESSION_AUTH_REQUIRED`, the message's first line for `AGENT_SESSION_BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE`); for any other error it is the error message's first line cut to 120 characters, and `probe failed` when that is empty.

Return results in `ACP_CHAT_AGENTS` order (`claude`, `codex`, `cursor`) after all probes settle, including not-installed results without launching those agents. Success with no models still returns learned with models 0. Keep using the memoized binary discovery from the catalog rather than rescanning installations. Reuse US-002's in-flight probes and its late-result shutdown guards and US-001's safe persistence path. Existing NaxError auth/backend reason behavior remains authoritative; generic probe failures do not set unavailable.

When the host returns learned 3 for claude, not installed for codex, and failed with not logged in for cursor, call `show` separately in that order with `Claude Code: 3 models`, `Codex: not installed`, `Cursor: failed: not logged in`. Use `acpAgentLabel` and singular `1 model` versus `0 models`/`N models`. A missing optional host method or [] result prints `no ACP agents to refresh`. Return no picker outcome and never switch the session for refresh.

Fixture migration: add `refresh: async () => []` to catalog stubs in `test/unit/cli/chat.test.ts`, `test/unit/cli/chat-resources.test.ts`, `test/unit/chat/chat-host-acp-models.test.ts`, `chat-host-acp-switch.test.ts`, and `test/unit/chat/acp/acp-host.test.ts`; use `refresh: mock(async () => [])` in `test/unit/chat/chat-host-acp.test.ts` and add delegation/absent-catalog cases there. Existing assertions remain unchanged. Add dedicated `test/unit/chat/acp/acp-catalog-refresh.test.ts` for result order, counts, failure reasons and warm/refresh sharing, and `test/unit/tui/chat/slash-commands-model-refresh.test.ts` mirroring the fake-host style of `slash-commands-acp.test.ts`. Use fake probes/sessions only.

**Scope** — In: catalog refresh and exported result union, optional host method and delegation, exact refresh slash dispatch, result formatting, tests and structural fake updates. Out: offer-store implementation (US-001); probe factory and startup lifecycle implementation (US-002). A progress note while `/model refresh` waits on its probes; the result lines appear when every probe has settled. Re-checking whether an agent's binary is installed during a chat: the install probe runs once per catalog, so an agent installed mid-chat reads `not installed` in `/model refresh` until the next chat. The `/help` text and `COMMAND_DESCRIPTIONS.model` are unchanged; `/model refresh` is not listed separately in the slash menu. Changing how an ACP open applies a requested model or effort, or how `acpModelRows` / `acpEffortLevels` filter offered ids.

**Interface** — `AcpRefreshResult` (US-003, exported from `acp-catalog.ts` and the `@/chat/acp` barrel):
```ts
export type AcpRefreshResult =
  | { readonly agent: AcpChatAgent; readonly outcome: "learned"; readonly models: number }
  | { readonly agent: AcpChatAgent; readonly outcome: "not installed" }
  | { readonly agent: AcpChatAgent; readonly outcome: "failed"; readonly reason: string };
```
Add `refresh(cwd: string): Promise<readonly AcpRefreshResult[]>` to `AcpCatalog` and `refreshAcpModels?(): Promise<readonly AcpRefreshResult[]>` to `ChatHost`. `NativeChatHost.refreshAcpModels()` delegates with its cwd and returns an empty list without a catalog. Forward the type through the umbrella chat barrel if needed by consumers while keeping named barrel imports.
acceptanceCriteria: [unit] catalog.refresh("/r") with every agent installed calls probeAcpAgent once per agent with cwd /r, including an agent that already has a saved or learned offer.
[unit] refresh resolves one result per agent in the order claude, codex, cursor.
[unit] For an agent whose probe resolves { offeredModels: ["a", "b"] }, its result is { agent, outcome: "learned", models: 2 } and rows() then includes acp:<agent>/a and acp:<agent>/b.
[unit] For an agent whose binary does not resolve, its result is { agent, outcome: "not installed" } and no probe runs for it.

[unit] For an agent whose probe rejects with a NaxError coded AGENT_SESSION_AUTH_REQUIRED, its result is { agent, outcome: "failed", reason: "not logged in" }; for one that rejects with a plain Error("boom\nmore"), its result is { agent, outcome: "failed", reason: "boom" }.
[unit] refresh called while a warm probe for codex is pending reuses that probe: probeAcpAgent is called for codex only once and the codex result reflects that probe's outcome.
[unit] NativeChatHost.refreshAcpModels() calls its catalog's refresh once with the host's cwd and resolves what refresh resolves.
[unit] NativeChatHost.refreshAcpModels() on a host built without a catalog resolves [].

[unit] /model refresh with a host whose refreshAcpModels resolves [{ agent: "claude", outcome: "learned", models: 3 }, { agent: "codex", outcome: "not installed" }, { agent: "cursor", outcome: "failed", reason: "not logged in" }] shows Claude Code: 3 models, Codex: not installed and Cursor: failed: not logged in as three transcript notes in that order, and does not call host.switchTo.
[unit] /model refresh calls host.refreshAcpModels exactly once and returns no picker outcome.
[unit] /model refresh with a host that has no refreshAcpModels, or whose refreshAcpModels resolves [], shows no ACP agents to refresh.
[unit] A learned result with models: 1 shows 1 model (singular), for example Codex: 1 model.
[unit] For an agent whose probe resolves { offeredEfforts: ["low"] } with no models, its result is { agent, outcome: "learned", models: 0 } and /model refresh shows <Label>: 0 models for it.

[unit] For an agent whose probe rejects with a NaxError coded AGENT_SESSION_BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE and message "spawn failed\ndetail" (a newline between the two lines), its result's reason is spawn failed; for one that rejects with new Error(""), its reason is probe failed.
[unit] /model Refresh calls host.switchTo({ model: "Refresh" }) and not refreshAcpModels; /model refresh extra calls refreshAcpModels once and not switchTo.
[unit] A probe that rejects with an error whose first line is 200 characters long gives a failed reason of exactly its first 120 characters.
[unit] /model acp:codex/m1 still calls host.switchTo({ model: "acp:codex/m1" }), and /model with no argument still returns the model picker outcome.

routing.reasoning: Adds a result union, catalog batch refresh, host delegation and slash formatting across existing modules, reusing US-002's probe lifecycle and in-flight sharing; strict TDD remains required by the session/authentication security override.

suggestedCriteria: When two refresh calls overlap for an agent, both receive the same probe outcome and only one probe runs for that agent.
When one refresh has completed and a later refresh begins, the later refresh re-probes every installed agent rather than reusing settled outcomes.
When refresh reports model ids that acpModelRows deduplicates or filters, the learned models count still equals the number of ids the probe reported.

analysis:
Goal and delivery: close #2746 by making each installed ACP agent's models and efforts discoverable before its first real open in a chat process. Deliver exactly US-001 persistence, US-002 startup probing, and US-003 explicit refresh, in that dependency order, entirely within packages/nax. This is an enhancement, not greenfield development. No dependency, release, configuration-schema or cross-package implementation change is needed. Navigation used direct reads and text searches because the codebase-memory MCP is unavailable in this session.

Verified architecture and current behavior: packages/nax/src/chat/acp/acp-catalog.ts:21 exposes _acpCatalogDeps with launchCandidateKind; :23 defines the six-member AcpCatalog; :61 maps authentication/backend failures; :69 creates process-local model, effort and failure maps. Its installedAgents closure at :75 memoizes binary discovery once per catalog using the supplied env. rows at :83 always emits bare agent rows, including unavailable agents, and appends acpModelRows output. opened at :102 updates reported lists and clears a failure, while failed at :113 records only recognized NaxError codes. packages/nax/src/chat/acp/acp-model.ts:13 fixes agent order to claude, codex, cursor; :29 provides labels Claude Code, Codex, Cursor; :108 filters/deduplicates picker rows and applies Cursor-specific bracket disambiguation, while :118 filters effort names into canonical order. Keep these helpers unchanged: refresh model counts measure reported ids, not picker row counts. packages/nax/src/chat/acp/acp-host.ts:26 wraps the existing session opener; :38 reports the successful session's actual model and backend capabilities, so retaining this wrapper automatically makes real opens persistent after US-001. It must continue forwarding/rethrowing existing behavior unchanged.

Composition/lifetime integration: packages/nax/src/cli/chat.ts:249 composeChat discovers native models and resources, builds a logger at :263, and currently creates the ACP catalog inline at :271. Extract one catalog, pass env, resolveChatSessionsDir(env), and this same logger, await its load before createChatHost, then pass the same instance to the host. startHost at packages/nax/src/cli/chat.ts:107 supports both new sessions and resume/switch; the await at :292 must finish before warm(cwd), and startup failure must never warm. The shell starts at :301; warming is fire-and-forget and must not delay it. packages/nax/src/chat/open-chat-session.ts:91 resolves the sessions directory from NAX_AGENT_SESSIONS_DIR or defaultSessionsDir(globalConfigDir()), and the chat barrel already exports it at packages/nax/src/chat/index.ts:77. Do not change directory resolution or native discoverModels. packages/nax/src/chat/chat-host.ts:79 defines ChatHost and :112 ChatHostDeps already accepts an optional catalog. The constructor at :163 wraps opens with reportAcpOpens; models at :257 reads catalog rows live, so future picker opens naturally observe saved/probed models without a subscription or picker rerender. close at :547 memoizes teardown; teardown at :557 must synchronously call catalog.close before awaiting the sessionOperations drain at :560. Add optional ChatHost.refreshAcpModels and implement delegation using deps.cwd, returning [] without a catalog.

Persistence design: create acp-offer-store.ts and its mirrored unit test. Mirror the injectable Bun.write plus sibling UUID temp path and renameSync pattern in packages/nax/src/chat/jobs/job-store.ts:15 and :40, including recursive parent creation and best-effort unlink on failure; unlike writeJobRecord, the new store's save must reject with the original write/rename error (US-001 AC-9), not wrap it. Store file is acp-offers.json with version 1 and an agents object; accept only known agent keys, require an array of models per entry, discard non-strings, default malformed/missing efforts to []. Preserve agent-provided id bytes rather than applying picker filtering to storage. _acpOfferStoreDeps must expose all external effects, including temp cleanup. Missing file is silent; unreadable/invalid JSON/unsupported-version input returns an empty map, logs one chat warn naming the path, and is not deleted. Avoid duplicate warnings: production store load handles its own errors; catalog.load catches an unexpectedly rejecting injected store and warns once. Catalog catches save rejections once, without affecting opened or causing unhandled rejections. Optional sessionsDir preserves existing memory-only consumers. Serialize fire-and-forget snapshot saves across settlements, recovering after rejection; include all currently known nonempty-model offers, omit efforts-only agents. Mark process-learned agents independently of nonempty-model status so late load cannot override a real opened report. Saved data only fills agents not learned in this process.

Important regression detail: packages/nax/src/chat/acp/acp-catalog.ts:49 reportedStrings currently returns undefined for empty or non-array reports. Existing tests at packages/nax/test/unit/chat/acp/acp-catalog.test.ts:49, :57, :65 and :99 explicitly require retaining prior models/efforts for absent/empty reports. The target says opened keeps the same behavior and adds saving; do not silently clear prior nonempty lists. Presence of a reported array for save triggering and tracking process learning is separate from whether that array contributes nonempty strings. A fresh agent reporting only efforts still has no known offer, is not saved, and can be probed next start; refresh returns learned with models 0 based on that probe's report, not any retained older rows.

Probe boundary: create acp-probe.ts and its mirrored unit test. packages/nax/src/chat/acp/acp-session-options.ts:55 already uses acpBackend through @nathapp/nax-agent-acp/client with allowUnsandboxed and inheritEnv true. packages/nax/src/chat/subagent-session.ts:44 and :89 demonstrate injectable createAgentSession/createMemoryTranscriptStore. The public CreateAgentSessionOptions at packages/nax-agent/src/session/agent-session-types.ts:58 requires backend, profile and transcriptStore, allows workdir/tools, and does not require instructions or sessionId. Probe with profile ask, workdir cwd, tools [], a memory transcript, and initializeTimeoutMs 20_000. Never send a prompt or attach chat workflow tools. Return session.backend.capabilities and swallow close rejection in finally; creation rejection must propagate unchanged. packages/nax-agent-acp/src/client/options.ts:23 sets the normal 60_000 ms default, and packages/nax-agent-acp/src/client/open.ts:169 applies the supplied initialize timeout per open step; this feature uses that existing bounded mechanism, not a new total-duration timer/config key or cancellation facility. packages/nax-agent-acp/src/client/offered-choices.ts:22 sanitizes/deduplicates/caps reported ids and :53 returns them in capabilities; the cache must not alter them. These library files are read-only context, not work targets.

Concurrency and lifetime risks: warm must remember startup attempts independently of in-flight state, so an agent reporting no models or failing is not repeatedly warmed in one start, but is retried next process start. Use a per-agent in-flight probe shared by warm and refresh; clear it when settled so later manual refresh can actually re-probe. Handle every failure and attach rejection handling immediately. Success routes through opened; failure routes through failed plus debug logging. Generic errors do not mark unavailable. A terminal closed flag must suppress both success and failure state changes and persistence for late probes without awaiting or killing those probes. Track process learning separately from saved fills to resolve load/open races. Refresh must await all outcomes, not reject the whole batch for an agent failure, and return claude/codex/cursor order even if settlements differ. Existing backend/auth failure reasons take priority; otherwise use the first message line capped at 120 characters or probe failed for empty text. Concurrent real opens and probes are both learned-this-process events; the spec does not introduce a new priority between these two sources.

UI integration: packages/nax/src/tui/chat/slash-commands.ts:87 parses arguments without lowercasing; :246 currently returns the model picker on no argument and otherwise switches by the first argument. Branch only on the exact first argument refresh; ignore additional arguments for this branch, retain ordinary switch behavior for Refresh and acp:codex/m1. Await optional host.refreshAcpModels once, print one show call per agent result using acpAgentLabel and singular/plural model counts, or exactly no ACP agents to refresh when the method is absent/empty. Do not modify help/menu descriptions. Export AcpRefreshResult from acp-catalog and packages/nax/src/chat/acp/index.ts:1; the umbrella packages/nax/src/chat/index.ts:1 is the import boundary used by slash commands and may forward the type if needed. Preserve named barrel imports and existing package boundaries: nax-agent public entry for session primitives, ACP client subpath for backend construction; never import nax-ai for this work.

outOfScope: An open `/model` picker does not re-render when a probe finishes; the new rows appear the next time the picker opens (`ChatHost.models` already reads the catalog live).
Hiding the probe's session from the agent's own session or resume list: an agent such as Claude Code or Codex may list the short probe session as one of its sessions.
Killing an in-flight probe's agent process when the chat quits; `close()` only drops the probe's result, and the process ends when its open settles or the nax process exits.

Re-checking whether an agent's binary is installed during a chat: the install probe runs once per catalog, so an agent installed mid-chat reads `not installed` in `/model refresh` until the next chat.
A progress note while `/model refresh` waits on its probes; the result lines appear when every probe has settled.
Merging the offers file across concurrent chat processes: each save rewrites the whole file atomically, and the last writer wins.
Expiry or a time-to-live on saved offers: a saved offer stays until a later open, probe or refresh replaces it.
Probing on a schedule, or probing again during a chat other than through `/model refresh`.
Changing how an ACP open applies a requested model or effort, or how `acpModelRows` / `acpEffortLevels` filter offered ids.
The `/help` text and `COMMAND_DESCRIPTIONS.model` are unchanged; `/model refresh` is not listed separately in the slash menu.
